cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(humble_dev_smoke)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(controller_interface REQUIRED)
find_package(hardware_interface REQUIRED)
find_package(tf2_ros REQUIRED)
find_package(urdf REQUIRED)
find_package(humble_dev_interfaces REQUIRED)
add_executable(dev_smoke main.cpp)
ament_target_dependencies(dev_smoke rclcpp humble_dev_interfaces)
install(TARGETS dev_smoke DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_gtest REQUIRED)
  ament_add_gtest(test_generated_message test_message.cpp)
  ament_target_dependencies(test_generated_message humble_dev_interfaces)
endif()
ament_package()
